# Component and Target Resolution for Coverage Claims

Provides utilities to resolve which entities a test can legitimately claim to cover, account for asymmetry between 'api' and 'symbols' target kinds, and map claimed elements back to their owning components. This avoids ambiguity and ensures accurate attribution of coverage and mutation results in reports.
